<!-- Write in English. See docs/review-guidelines.md for review expectations. -->

## Summary

Describe what changed.

## Outcome

Describe what changes as a result, including before/after behavior when useful.

## Validation

Describe how the change was validated.

## Related issues

Link relevant issues. Use closing keywords (for example, `Closes #123`) only when
the Issue is fully addressed. For partial work, state what remains and keep the
Issue open.
